claims.title: Separate mechanical comparison, prepared actuation energy and pressure-force bias in repair and growth feedback

quoted_fields.interface: Quasistatic positive Hookean stiffnesses, fixed common displacement/geometry and actual force attachment. The spring bound uses R>0,k>=0 and the stated linear port. Work release additionally requires a prepared initial state and paid loading/reset path. Earlier cubic, stock, calibration and observation units retain their own assumptions; no physical valve follows from a signal equation.
quoted_fields.failure: A1038 remains current for the three unchanged earlier units. New code describes its Fb formula as force on one midpoint, but R*Fb is the equal-and-opposite differential-force case; do not transfer it to arbitrary one-node pressure. The source stationary energy formula alone does not establish releasable work from a freely relaxed state or a repeatable energy-harvesting cycle. Component papers, dimensional valve/flow/noise/oxygen/pH examples and randomized checks remain source reports. No integrated pilot/culture, absolute strength/fatigue certificate or practical advantage is acquired.
